description: Produce a durable onboarding artifact for a codebase — writes ONBOARDING.md covering a "read this first" minimum, system overview, dependency map, startup flow, auth flow, and 5-15 important files, every claim backed by file:line citations; refreshes an existing onboarding doc instead of rewriting it. Use this skill whenever the user says "explain this codebase", "explain the codebase", "onboard me", "give me a tour", "tour this repo", "what does this repo do", "where do I start", "codebase overview", "read this first", "I haven't looked at this in months", or "/codebase-explainer" — even if they don't name the skill.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
